# Rudersdal

Rudersdal is a Danish municipality whose local healthcare outcomes are monitored as part of national clinical quality benchmarking. Specifically, it is included in the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK), published by the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP) [^src1]. 

The report evaluates the clinical quality of atrial fibrillation treatment across Denmark, with a specific focus on Indicator 5, which tracks the prevention of ischemic strokes through anticoagulant (AC) treatment [^src1]. To support local quality development and benchmarking within the Danish healthcare system, the report breaks down data from the Danish Stroke Registry (DanStroke) and the National Patient Registry (LPR) across all 98 Danish municipalities [^src1]. Rudersdal's specific statistical data regarding stroke events among atrial fibrillation patients is documented in the municipal breakdown for Indicator 5 on page 93 of the report [^src1].
